metadata.description: PM Co-Pilot, forked for a multi-client delivery role: a personal operating system for Claude that learns you, tracks clients and their projects, runs a three-pass daily rhythm built around an overnight team handoff, and drafts weekly client status updates.

plugins.name: pm-copilot
plugins.description: Turns Claude into a co-pilot for multi-client delivery work: two morning-brief passes, an end-of-day handoff check, weekly prep, weekly client-status drafts, open loops, and self-improvement, all sweeping every active client and project, not one board. Tool-agnostic in spirit, built against ClickUp, Slack, and Google Chat.
